page.overview:
Who is Rings?

Rings was a combatant in the Battle Nexus Tournament. He was eliminated in Tier 1 by .

When the tournament arena separates the Battle Nexus fighters into pairs, finds himself facing Rings. The two exchange blows for a short while, with Raphael blocking Rings' blows with his sai. Then Rings throws two of his metal rings at Raphael, who dodges them. They trade strikes and then Raphael flips high over Rings' head. When Rings turns, Raphael kicks him so hard that Rings drops his weapons and sways on his feet. Just as Raphael stabs with one of his sai, Rings is teleported out of the arena and the tournament.

Rings' disk weapon resembles to an Indian Rujput warroir's [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chakram Chakrams]. Category:Battle Nexus contestants
